doctrine: capability authority = kernel projection over evidenceEvents; FSRS = scheduling only; no deletions in Wave 2

nodes.title: Authority guardrails
nodes.currentAuthority: heuristic stores mint implicit capability claims (accuracy, due-ness, weakSpots.resolved, pronunciationProgress, assessment.currentLevel)
nodes.targetAuthority: capability claims originate only from kernel projection over evidenceEvents
nodes.action: Freeze new authority violations. Forbid new readers treating records.accuracy, fsrsCard/nextReview due-ness, weakSpots.resolved, pronunciationProgress, or assessment.currentLevel as capability. Enforced via review checklist + invariant grep list in ADR.
nodes.rollback: Remove the policy; no data touched.
invariants: no new ability-claim readers outside evidence-bridge projectState
FSRS due-ness never implies mastery
completion never implies mastery
acceptance: grep inventory of ability-claim read sites lands in this doc
STATE_AUTHORITY.md invariant column cites this node
stopConditions: any existing reader found minting new capability claims -> escalate, scope guardrail first

nodes.title: Semantic commit contract
nodes.currentAuthority: legacy tables commit in one Dexie transaction; EvidenceEvent would be a later best-effort side write
nodes.targetAuthority: semantic outcome and legacy history commit atomically in one local transaction
nodes.action: Decide commit semantics: extend the existing Dexie transactions to include db.evidenceEvents so history+event commit atomically. evaluate -> construct event -> single local tx -> remote sync separately. Rejected alternative: post-commit side write (split-brain).
nodes.adapter: evidence-bridge submitAttempt/submitObservation write inside the caller's Dexie transaction scope
nodes.syncImpact: no sync change for the commit itself; event mirror is W2-SY1
nodes.rollback: Adapter stops emitting events; legacy transaction shape unchanged.
invariants: a semantic outcome in history implies a matching event committed in the same transaction
embedded self/AI feedback inside an attempt never mints capability events
remote sync failure never blocks the local semantic commit
acceptance: failure matrix F1/F2/F3 answered in ADR
atomicity test plan: event absent => whole transaction absent
stopConditions: evidenceEvents cannot join the existing transaction -> must switch to durable outbox design before any W2 adapter code

nodes.title: Placement boundary contract
nodes.currentAuthority: assessment-store.currentLevel (localStorage) displays a CEFR level as ability
nodes.targetAuthority: explicit non-authoritative placement domain: PlacementEstimate advisory state; never an EvidenceEvent, never capability truth
readers: assessment flow (assessment-section display + next-quiz seeding via /api/assessment)
nodes.action: Define the placement domain as advisory state outside the event log: PlacementEstimate { levelEstimate, source, score, completedAt, method/version }. EvidenceEvent stays capability-scoped — placement_estimate is NOT a registered event type, ai_eval is NOT an authority, and submitObservation is a capability-bound TaskContract API, not a generic observation bus. Reviewer decision: do not extend the kernel to hold placement; audited placement evidence would require a separate ADR (separate placement/history domain or a generic non-capability ledger).
nodes.adapter: none — advisory state, no event emission
nodes.backfill: HISTORY ONLY — the stored CEFR label is never replayed as an event
nodes.syncImpact: no sync change — assessment-store stays localStorage prefs
nodes.rollback: Boundary doc + label revert; no data touched.
invariants: placement estimate never enters capability projection inputs
no capability promotion, prerequisite satisfaction, mission completion, retained/transfer credit, or projection override may read placement state
UI always labels it as an estimate
permitted uses only: learner-facing orientation, onboarding suggestion, optional initial-content recommendation
acceptance: no capability projection reads placement state
placement value is typed and persisted as an estimate (verbatim UI copy relabel owned by W2-AS1)
stopConditions: audited placement evidence desired -> separate ADR first; do not expand EvidenceEvent in Wave 2

nodes.title: Projection coverage audit
nodes.currentAuthority: projection exists (projectLearnerState, buildLearnerModel, deriveCorrectionEpisodes) but coverage vs required consumer constructs is unverified
nodes.targetAuthority: every consumer-facing construct has a named kernel projection artifact
nodes.action: Produce the coverage table: required construct -> kernel artifact (CAPABILITY_STATES, deriveCorrectionEpisodes, deriveSupportLifecycle, fn-gap ledgers, next-for-you selector) -> present|missing. Missing constructs route to W2-PC1.
invariants: no consumer migration may begin against a construct marked missing
acceptance: each missing construct names its prerequisite node
stopConditions: any missing construct -> W2-PC1 becomes required before its dependents

nodes.title: Kernel projection extension
nodes.targetAuthority: missing constructs implemented in kernel, not shimmed in UI
nodes.action: Always executes as a gate node; it never disappears from the DAG. Consumes W2-G04's recorded coverage result: if missingConstructs is non-empty, implement exactly those constructs in kernel (candidate: standalone recurring-error surface if correction episodes do not cover it) with contracts registered in the bridge registry; if empty, resolve skipped-satisfied with recorded result missingConstructs=[]. Downstream nodes depend on this gate's recorded resolution, not on optional work. Additive kernel work only.
nodes.rollback: Extension is additive; dependents keep legacy reads.
invariants: no construct may be simulated in UI code — kernel or nothing
resolution is always recorded (implemented | skipped-satisfied), never implicit
acceptance: either constructs present with contract + kernel tests, or recorded resolution skipped-satisfied with missingConstructs=[]
stopConditions: G04 coverage result missing or unrecorded -> gate cannot resolve; block dependents

nodes.title: Weakness construct mapping
nodes.currentAuthority: weakSpots rows: module+weakSpotType+normalizedText keyed, count + resolved flag
nodes.targetAuthority: distinct kernel constructs: consecutive failure, recurring error, support dependency, remediation demand
nodes.action: Define each selected construct: source EvidenceEvents, projection field, decay/resolution condition, planner use, UI wording, capability-specific flag. Map: recurring error -> correction-episode triggers (deriveCorrectionEpisodes); support dependency -> support lifecycle state (learner-model view); remediation demand -> open episode + retestSurfaces; consecutive failure -> support-demand ledger input. Legacy count/resolved never copied.
nodes.backfill: HISTORY ONLY — generic weakSpot rows never mint events
nodes.rollback: Mapping doc only; no reads switched yet.
invariants: no generic 'weak' boolean may ship
UI wording comes from construct semantics (e.g. needs practice / recovering), not from weakSpots.count
acceptance: missing kernel support routed to W2-PC1 explicitly
stopConditions: required construct absent and not coverable -> escalate to external review

nodes.title: Attempt dual-write adapter
nodes.currentAuthority: learningAttempts/sessions/records commit locally; no EvidenceEvent minted
nodes.targetAuthority: semantic outcomes mint EvidenceEvents inside the same Dexie transaction
nodes.action: Extend the existing Dexie transactions to include evidenceEvents; submitAttempt writes history rows + the semantic event atomically. TextCycleEvidence/cycle data maps to contract-registered task outcomes; embedded feedback stays context-only.
nodes.rollback: Stop emitting; legacy rows identical to today.
invariants: attempt with semantic outcome => event in same transaction
feedback.source self/ai never appears in evaluation.authority for capability claims
acceptance: atomicity test: history committed <=> event committed
falsification e2e re-pinned: double-submit mints one attempt, corrupted rows earn nothing
stopConditions: single-transaction commit impossible -> durable outbox per W2-G02 decision

nodes.title: Weak-spot read migration
nodes.currentAuthority: lesson-workshop, use-review-summary, use-learning-workspace read weakSpots table
nodes.targetAuthority: surfaces read correction-episode/support-lifecycle projection; weakSpots table demoted to candidate signal
writers: weak-spots-store.ts keeps writing candidate signal (sync mirror compat)
nodes.action: Repoint the three readers to projection constructs per W2-WS1 mapping. Legacy writer output may feed candidate-signal events, never authority.
nodes.rollback: Readers switch back to the table; both sources coexist.
invariants: no UI weakness/resolved claim without projection source
acceptance: all three readers use projection; falsification spec covers stale-table case
stopConditions: projection diverges unexplainably from expectations -> keep dual-read, escalate

nodes.title: Planner authority migration
nodes.currentAuthority: daily-task-planner selects over legacy records/sessions heuristics; dailyTasks mixes row classes
nodes.targetAuthority: kernel nextAction/selectNextTask decides; planner-generated dailyTasks rows record the decision id
nodes.action: Split dailyTasks row semantics: planner-generated learning rows (require decision provenance), lifecycle rows, settings/preferences rows (e.g. preferences:vocabulary — exempt). Selection logic delegated to kernel; rows are executable cache. Legacy queued tasks keep completing as cache — no re-authorization.
nodes.syncImpact: no sync change — dailyTasks stays sync mirror of generated cache
nodes.rollback: Planner flag returns to legacy budget selection; existing rows still render.
invariants: every planner-generated learning task row traces to a planner decision id
settings/preferences rows never require decision provenance
acceptance: decision-id provenance on new planner rows
stopConditions: nextAction coverage insufficient for task kinds -> route via W2-PC1

nodes.title: Assessment placement relabel
nodes.targetAuthority: advisory placement-estimate label; no capability or gating consumers
readers: assessment flow (assessment-section display + next-quiz seeding via /api/assessment)
nodes.action: Relabel UI copy to placement estimate; remove capability/gating consumers; preserve history. Does NOT emit submitObservation and does NOT invent a capability/task contract — placement stays outside the event log per the W2-G03 boundary.
invariants: placement estimate never feeds capability state
no gating consumes currentLevel
stopConditions: placement boundary undefined -> block on W2-G03

nodes.title: pronunciationProgress demotion
nodes.currentAuthority: per-sound progress row renders as ability
nodes.targetAuthority: practice/diagnostic history display only; capability claims wait for Wave-3 acoustic EvidenceEvents
nodes.action: Presentation reads as practice history. No acoustic eval in W2 — OpenPronounce audit is a W3 gate.
nodes.backfill: HISTORY ONLY — progress scores never mint events
nodes.syncImpact: no sync change — stays raw-synced compat table
invariants: strong-looking progress with zero acoustic events must not surface as ability

nodes.title: Memory boundary verification
nodes.currentAuthority: records.fsrsCard + favorites.fsrsCard drive scheduling; occasionally read as ability
nodes.targetAuthority: FSRS stays memory-scheduling authority; all readers verified scheduling-only
nodes.action: Audit every fsrsCard/nextReview reader; demote ability-shaped reads (e.g. last_review as review evidence) to scheduling context; pin with grep list.
nodes.backfill: NONE — scheduling state stays live authority
nodes.syncImpact: no sync change — records keep mapped sync
invariants: due-ness never implies mastery
retention claims come only from projection

nodes.title: Consumer sweep
nodes.currentAuthority: dashboard/recommendations/review read capability-shaped data from legacy stores
nodes.targetAuthority: capability surfaces read exclusively from projectState/learner model
nodes.action: Repoint remaining capability-claim readers to the projection. sessions.avgAccuracy and streaks stay display-only analytics.
invariants: avgAccuracy display-only, never proficiency
no direct ability reads outside projection
stopConditions: surface has no projection construct -> prerequisite via W2-PC1

nodes.title: Writer freeze completion
nodes.currentAuthority: legacy writers write history + implicit claims
nodes.targetAuthority: legacy writers write history only; adapter is sole semantic-outcome path
nodes.action: Complete the freeze: no writer mints capability claims outside the bridge. Falsification + meet-person e2e pins re-run as the gate.
invariants: semantic truth flows only through evidenceEvents

nodes.title: evidenceEvents sync mirror
readers: sync engine pull on other devices
nodes.action: Add append-only event mirror. Events are immutable -> conflict handling is dedupe by deterministic id, never merge. Local projection remains the computation point.
nodes.backfill: NONE — mirror starts from creation; local log remains source during transition
nodes.syncImpact: sync mapper change + remote schema (append-only table) + conflict handling (id dedupe)
nodes.rollback: Stop syncing events; local log unaffected.
invariants: mirror never rewrites events
a stale synced legacy row arriving post-freeze applies as history only, never authority
acceptance: legacy rows post-freeze do not alter capability state
stopConditions: remote schema requires destructive migration -> escalate

nodes.title: Replay + sync verification
nodes.targetAuthority: projection reproducible from event replay; edge cases covered
nodes.action: Verify: multi-tab same-version behavior, downgrade (old app reads legacy tables fine, events inert), anonymous->authenticated transition (events carry learnerId; namespace migration plan documented), stale sync rows post-freeze, replay equivalence.
invariants: replay determinism: same events -> same projection
acceptance: edge-case matrix in ADR all answered by tests or explicit doctrine

nodes.title: Fact-preserving backfill gate
nodes.currentAuthority: legacy history exists without semantic events
nodes.targetAuthority: only provably-fact-preserving sources may mint historical_replay events, via separate review
nodes.action: Separate review gate. Eligibility requires raw learner response + stable task identity/revision + context + evaluator inputs + support provenance where the contract demands it. Re-evaluate against frozen contract; never copy the old verdict; deterministic id; provenance historical_replay.
nodes.backfill: FACT-PRESERVING CANDIDATE — only rows passing the eligibility proof
invariants: no synthetic semantic backfill by default
sessions.accuracy never becomes mastery evidence
uncopyable aggregate rows stay history forever
acceptance: external review approves the candidate set
stopConditions: eligibility proof cannot be demonstrated -> source stays HISTORY ONLY

nodes.title: Retirement planning
nodes.currentAuthority: legacy tables still authoritative for some reads
nodes.targetAuthority: documented pruning candidates + gate; no deletion in Wave 2
nodes.action: Document which tables become prune candidates (weakSpots, obsolete planner cache classes) and what evidence must exist before any deletion. Actual pruning is a separate post-W2 gate with external review.
invariants: no table deletion inside Wave 2
